profile_model: profile a PyTorch model to measure CPU and CUDA execution times per operator
compute_flops: compute the number of FLOPs needed for a forward pass of a PyTorch model
compute_activations: compute the number of activations created during a forward pass of a PyTorch model
count_params: count the total number of parameters in a PyTorch nn.Module model
summarize_profiler_info: summarize torch autograd profiler statistics into a formatted string with CPU and CUDA times
